subject: Page space running out in Shiny Dashboard - Don't know what to do

messages.author: e094d92c0ad78ebc
messages.subject: Page space running out in Shiny Dashboard - Don't know what to do
parts:
Is anyone experienced with Shiny/Shiny-Dashboard that they know how to fix this issue?

I'm making an application to visualize multiple graphs on one page. The problem is that the page space seems very limited, and I barely have enough room to fit one graph. 
  • If you click on the Interaction tab, the bar graphs overlap
  • In the Cyst Data tab -> Beeswarm, my box plots quickly run out of the page
Ideally, I would like more page space, so that 1) my bar graphs won't overlap, 2) I can scroll down to see the rest of my box plots without running into white space

Does anyone know how to fix this?
